title: CrossChainCircuit
tagline: Solution for cross-chain communication for SAFEs using Hyperlane and NOUNS DAO branded artwork
description: Cross-chain Circuit is an innovative project that addresses the critical challenge of cross-chain communication for SAFEs in the blockchain space. Leveraging the power of Hyperlane, a cutting-edge decentralized infrastructure, and NOUNS DAO's captivating branded artwork, this project aims to enable seamless and secure communication between SAFEs operating on different blockchain networks.
how_its_made:
The project was bootstrapped using template for SAFE dApps from SAFE that was previously created by their core team members: https://github.com/5afe/safe-core-protocol-demo/tree/main/web

Rest of the features were my own experimentation with safe core SDK, Hyperlane and React.js, tailwind and ethers.
